sentences.en: This stage is marked by obvious physical changes such as swelling of the vulva and a bloody discharge, but the bitch is not yet receptive to breeding.

sentences.en: The vulva or pudendum comprises all the female external generative organs, and consists of the mons Veneris, labia majora and minora, clitoris, urethral orifice, hymen, bulbs of the vestibule, and glands of Bartholin.

sentences.en: Put the condom on before the penis touches the vulva, rectum, or mouth.

sentences.en: Nine patients who applied capsaicin topically to the vulva for 6 weeks reported " significant relief " .

sentences.en: Eggs are expelled to the exterior through a muscular vagina, ending in the small orifice of the vulva.

sentences.en: Herpes simplex and human papilloma virus, which is associated with warts, commonly affect the vulva.
